**What happened?**

**Steps to reproduce** (model, pose, tab, buttons)

**Model info** (vertex count, up axis, is it a real T-Pose? what does the status bar say?)

**Screenshot** (use *File > Screenshot*; "Show skeleton" helps a lot)

**Version** (Help > About) and Windows version
